card: Backports a compiler warning fix from PR #36869 to the 31.x maintenance branch alongside a release notes update. Newer Clang compilers (Clang 24) emit -Wunused-private-field warnings on helper structs in memusage.h whose fields exist solely for sizeof memory estimations and are never accessed directly. Making these fields public silences the compiler warning without altering struct alignment or memory accounting.
evidence: Commit 72d6048d5f quotes LLVM upstream: 'Since llvm/llvm-project#237374, Clang 24 diagnoses these fields with -Wunused-private-field.'
problem: Clang 24 diagnoses unused private fields in STL container helper structs with `-Wunused-private-field`, failing or cluttering builds on newer LLVM toolchains when building the 31.x maintenance branch.

risk.why: A mistake would only affect compiler warning emissions or internal memory usage estimation sizing.

scope_notes: Standard maintenance branch backport containing a cherry-picked build warning fix from master (#36869) and release notes changes.
summary: Backports PR #36869 to the 31.x release branch and updates the 31.x release notes. The backported change makes member fields of STL helper structs in memusage public to silence `-Wunused-private-field` compiler warnings.
